title: SIEM Knowledge Engineer
description: At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON ’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats. Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights , our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance. At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do: Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes. Customer-Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers. Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change. Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team. Role Summary: We are seeking a skilled technical communicator with expertise in cybersecurity, SIEM software, and related technologies. In this role, you will serve as a critical bridge between development teams in India and documentation teams in the US, ensuring the delivery of clear, accurate, and user-focused product content. Key Responsibilities: Develop a deep understanding of Securonix products , features, and enhancements. Test and validate new functionality to ensure documentation accuracy and completeness. Leverage the latest AI-driven tools to create, refine, and streamline technical content. Collaborate closely with developers and staff writers to produce comprehensive, user-friendly documentation . Create content that empowers customers to effectively deploy, manage, and succeed with our solutions. This is an opportunity to combine your technical expertise and communication skills to shape how customers interact with cutting-edge cybersecurity products. What You’ll Do & Achieve: Translate highly technical and complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for diverse audiences. Leverage AI tools (such as GPT) to automatically generate documentation content from technical sources—including design documents, transcripts, product specifications, code, and development tickets. Test product features under development and provide feedback on software usability, ensuring a positive user experience. Review and refine documentation to ensure technical accuracy, clarity, and consistency. Identify gaps in existing documentation and propose improvements based on user feedback and technical insights. Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years of experience as a Threat Intelligence Analyst, Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, Security Engineer, Threat Hunter, or related cybersecurity role. Proven hands-on experience with SIEM software, ideally Securonix SNYPR or Unified Defense SIEM (UDS), or tools such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Sentinel. Experience creating and using AI prompts to generate quality technical content. Proactive and self-motivated to seek information from various SMEs. Strong attention to detail. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. Proven ability to learn and master new products, tools, and technologies.
company_description:
Securonix is a unicorn in the cybersecurity industry and a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
Securonix was also named in the annual Security 100 list by CRN in 2024, and is a chosen cybersecurity provider for 1,000+ of the world’s largest and most respected enterprise and MSSP customers. Securonix is backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest Private Equity firms with more than $100 Billion of assets under management, a unique advantage for the company.

With its best-in-class, innovative unified platform offering SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, Securonix provides organizations with a content-driven threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR) solution. Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh open architecture on the highly scalable Snowflake data cloud.

Our innovative cloud-native solution is enhanced by Securonix EON, a suite of AI-Reinforced capabilities, to deliver a frictionless CyberOps experience for security analysts and CISOs and empowers them to scale their organization’s security operations and keep up with evolving threats. An award-winning organization, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do. These are the values we live and work by:

Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
Customer Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. We develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders.
